tiles.description: MISLABELLED: this frame is a sixth plant, a tall grass tuft, not a rock. The sheet carries six plants and seven rock groups; the tileset was written for five and eight, so every id from this frame on names the picture before it. The id is live in three rockPool entries of urban.mapping.json, which is why it is recorded here rather than quietly corrected: renaming it is a content change with its own review, not a re-export.
